statement:
Let me start by looking up the bonus record.
The recorded value of 1000.00 is not safe and correct, because the study specifies a bonus of only 1.00 US dollar per participant and the grant holds just 240.00 dollars, so applying 1000.00 — whether denominated in dollars, cents, or another unit — would far exceed both the intended amount and the available funding.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states "The recorded value of 1000.00 is not safe and correct" because it exceeds the $1.00 intended bonus and the $240 grant.
